title: Fictional child-support calculation inputs

parent.objective: Maintain a source-pinned child-support calculation for the fictional Doe v. Doe matter, distinguishing inputs recomputed by rule from figures a party has merely reported.
parent.milestone: Support-calculation inputs verified against primary financial records

goal: Recompute the fictional support-worksheet arithmetic from stated inputs and separately track which reported income figures have been checked against a primary financial record.
non_goals: Advise on relief, deviation, or enforcement.
Treat a party's reported income as established without a primary-source check.

allowed: Recompute the fictional worksheet's combined-income and pro-rata arithmetic.
Track fact status for each reported income figure.
prohibited: Assert a reported income figure as verified without a bound primary-source record.
Introduce real people, income figures, or financial records.

inputs.name: Fictional support worksheet inputs
inputs.description: Party A fictional reported gross monthly income $6,000; Party B fictional reported gross monthly income $4,000. Both fictional; establish no real financial fact.

outputs.name: Worksheet arithmetic record
outputs.description: Recomputed combined income and each party's pro-rata share.

outputs.name: Fact-status ledger
outputs.description: Each reported income figure tagged with its declared fact status and, where checked, the primary source consulted.

interface.name: fictional_support_worksheet
interface.description: Input reported figures; output recomputed arithmetic and a fact-status ledger.

assumptions: Both income figures are invented solely for this worked example.
Pro-rata share is each party's income divided by combined income.

sources.reference: The two fictional reported income figures embedded in this contract's inputs.
sources.authority: Synthetic fixture manifest only; no real financial record.

sources.reference: Fictional Party A financial-affidavit exhibit (illustrative only; not present in this repository).
sources.authority: Would be a primary financial record if real; here it is a synthetic placeholder for the worked example.

acceptance_criteria.description: Combined income and each party's pro-rata share are recomputed correctly from the stated inputs.
Party A's reported income is tracked as an inference until checked against a primary financial record, never presented as verified by repetition.

validation.description: Recompute combined income and pro-rata shares and compare to the worksheet.
evidence_required: Recomputed combined income and pro-rata shares compared to the stated worksheet values.

argv: a, b = 6000, 4000; combined = a + b; share_a = round(a / combined, 4); share_b = round(b / combined, 4); assert combined == 10000 and share_a == 0.6 and share_b == 0.4; print('worksheet arithmetic verified')

validation.description: A non-implementer reviews Party A's financial-affidavit exhibit and confirms whether it supports the reported income figure.
evidence_required: A source verification record binding the reviewed exhibit, its outcome, and the reviewing operator.

context_scope: This contract and the embedded fictional worksheet inputs.
The derived arithmetic record and fact-status ledger.
architecture_boundaries: Keep a reported figure distinct from a primary-source-verified figure until the ledger earns the upgrade.
Make no legal determination and perform no external writes.

fact_assertions.assertion: Party A's gross monthly income is $6,000.
